title: Require planning demonstrations to name an existing test seam
summary: Fix the shared cause behind the five introspections (and jobs 20261018-095726-r3bn, 20261018-113512-gvcs, 20261024-115052-bzw6): plan demonstrations need not name a test seam. Add a `seam` field to the demonstration record and output, make admission refuse behavior-criterion demonstrations without one, and update planner/critic prompts.

defaults_applied.how: New admission test plus cargo test, clippy, fmt criteria.
Rule enforced by an admission finding, not only prompt prose.
Fix at the plan template/admission, covering all five introspections.
Criteria run tests that fail without the check.
Outcome is plans being refused when the seam is unnamed.
One focused change to the demonstration record and its check.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: stop planning rounds being wasted when a demonstration assumes a test seam that does not exist; audience is the planner/critic loop and the maintainers reading plans.
Fix origin is the plan record and admission check (athena-core admission.rs) plus planner/critic prompts, i.e. a mechanism, not prose alone.
The `seam` field is optional in stored records for backward compatibility and required only by the admission check for behavior criteria.
The earlier jobs 20261018-095726-r3bn, 20261018-113512-gvcs, 20261024-115052-bzw6 are not retried here; their feature work is out of scope.
Deliverable list is a best guess; test files constructing Demonstration literals may need a one-line field addition.

acceptance_criteria.text: Root cause named in the change description and CHANGELOG.md: the plan template let a demonstration cite a command without naming the test seam (production entry point, how the fake is injected, whether the seam exists today or which step adds it); fixed in the plan record, output schema and admission check, not in any one job's plan.

Demonstration (athena-data records.rs) and DemonstrationOutput (athena-context outputs.rs) each gain a `seam` field, carried through the conversion in the run code and shown in the brief rendering in briefs.rs; older records without it still parse (optional with serde default).

crates/athena-context/prompts/planner.md tells the planner to name, per behavior criterion, the production function the demonstration calls, how the fake is injected, and quote the state guards on the path, and to add a plan step when the seam does not exist; critic.md tells the critic to check this against the code. Prompt token budgets stay within their limits (planner 494 left, critic 517 left).

Run `cargo test -p athena-core admission`: a new test shows that a plan whose behavior-criterion demonstration has no seam (missing or blank) gets a Major finding at 'demonstrations, criterion N', a plan with a seam passes, and a non-behavior (content) criterion needs no seam. The test fails with the admission check removed.

Run `cargo test` for the workspace: the existing planning tests (job_plan.rs, lifecycle.rs, fake agent plans) pass with the fake planner supplying seams, and a test shows the seam text appears in the rendered critic brief.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`: both clean; `cargo test` passes.

Prior jobs 20261018-095726-r3bn, 20261018-113512-gvcs and 20261024-115052-bzw6 are addressed as instances: each stopped after planning round 3 on a major finding that its criterion's demonstration used a seam (Athena::land_pr with a fake Remote/host, GitRemote::cut_head behind FakeRemote, Athena::land_pr wiring in drain) that did not exist or did not run production code. Their minor findings (extra files, exit codes, docs wording) belong to those jobs' own features and are not fixed here; this change prevents the class at admission.

out_of_scope: Retrying the features of jobs 20261018-095726-r3bn, 20261018-113512-gvcs and 20261024-115052-bzw6 (merge/resync, cut_head, records landing)
Changing the three-round planning cap or the critic's severity scale
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or CI workflows
Automatically probing the code to verify a seam exists
departures: Touches the planning record schema, prompts and admission across several crates, so cost and time are above the reference.
urgent_reason: Cuts failed planning rounds: five jobs stopped at round 3 on a nonexistent test seam.
hard_reason: Adds a rule in the admission check that can refuse plans and changes the run pipeline's planning record and gate.
